name: Camp Cedar
description_short: Overnight summer camp for boys ages 8 to 15 on Coffee Pond in Casco, Maine. For 2027 it offers a seven-week full session (June 27 to August 13); a limited number of first-time campers can come for 4 or 5 weeks.

sources.note: 2027 Dates and Rates: session dates and rates (7 weeks $18,100, 5 weeks $15,000, 4 weeks $12,700), summer address
FAQ: 270 boys ages 8-15 on Coffee Pond; program list; buses from Port Chester, Boston and Connecticut; family-style meals; shortened sessions limited to first-time campers

warnings: No prices appear on the 'Dates + Rates' page. There is another page at https://campcedar.com/dates-rates/ that may list rates, possibly for a different year.
The footer says ©2023, but the page lists 2027 dates. Check the dates with the camp.
The page also lists Rookie Day for prospective campers (Thu July 22), Visiting Day (Sat July 24) and a Father & Son Overnight (Aug 13-14). These are events, not bookable sessions.
The winter office is at 1758 Beacon Street, Brookline, MA 02445-2124, (617) 277-8080. The camp itself is in Casco, ME.
unknowns: Tuition/rates for each session (the page is titled 'Dates + Rates' but shows no prices)
Whether the camp is boys-only (the page mentions 'Email Your Son' and 'Father & Son Overnight' but does not say so directly)
Availability or enrollment status of sessions
Deposit, refund policy and financial aid
